name: Computer Networks
short_description: OSI and TCP/IP protocol stacks, IP routing, transport guarantees, and application protocols.
description: Comprehensive network architecture course spanning physical signaling, data link framing, IPv4/IPv6 subnetting, routing protocols (OSPF, BGP), reliable transport (TCP/UDP), and DNS/HTTP application layers.

courses.title: Computer Networks Fundamentals
courses.description: Layered network protocols, reliable packet delivery, IP routing, and sockets.

modules.title: Network Models
modules.description: OSI 7-layer model vs TCP/IP 4-layer model, encapsulation, and packet headers.

topics.title: Network Fundamentals, Topologies & Performance
topics.summary: Topologies, circuit and packet switching, and delay, throughput, and the bandwidth-delay product.

topics.title: OSI vs TCP/IP Protocol Stacks
topics.summary: Protocol layering, encapsulation, and header multiplexing.

modules.title: Physical Layer
modules.description: Bandwidth, Nyquist/Shannon capacity theorems, transmission media.

topics.title: Channel Capacity & Transmission Media
topics.summary: Signal attenuation, SNR, and Shannon limit bounds.

modules.title: Data Link Layer
modules.description: Framing, error detection (CRC), flow control, and CSMA/CD Ethernet.

topics.title: Framing, CRC & CSMA/CD Protocol
topics.summary: Bit stuffing, cyclic redundancy checks, and MAC broadcast domains.

topics.title: Error Correction & Sliding-Window Protocols
topics.summary: Hamming codes, stop-and-wait, Go-Back-N, and Selective Repeat ARQ.

topics.title: Ethernet, MAC Addressing & Switching
topics.summary: Ethernet frames, MAC addresses, learning switches, and VLANs.

modules.title: Network Layer
modules.description: Datagram forwarding, routing algorithms, virtual circuits.

topics.title: Routing Concepts & Distance Vector vs Link State
topics.summary: Dijkstra algorithm in OSPF and Bellman-Ford in RIP.

modules.title: IP Addressing
modules.description: IPv4 subnetting, CIDR prefix notation, NAT, and IPv6 headers.

topics.title: IPv4 Subnetting & CIDR Calculation
topics.summary: Network masks, usable host ranges, and broadcast boundaries.

topics.title: IPv6, ARP, ICMP & DHCP
topics.summary: IPv6 addressing and the support protocols that make IP work on a real network.

modules.title: Routing
modules.description: Autonomous systems, intra-domain routing (OSPF), and inter-domain routing (BGP).

topics.title: BGP & Inter-Domain Autonomous Routing
topics.summary: Path vector routing and AS peering policies.

modules.title: Transport Layer
modules.description: Port multiplexing, reliability, flow control, and congestion avoidance.

topics.title: TCP 3-Way Handshake & Flow Control
topics.summary: SYN/ACK flags, sequence numbers, and sliding window flow control.

modules.title: TCP / UDP
modules.description: Connection-oriented vs datagram transport comparison, AIMD congestion control.

topics.title: TCP Congestion Control vs UDP Low Latency
topics.summary: Slow start, congestion avoidance, fast retransmit, and UDP datagrams.

modules.title: Application Layer
modules.description: DNS hierarchy, HTTP/1.1 vs HTTP/2/3, TLS encryption handshakes.

topics.title: DNS & Modern HTTP Protocols
topics.summary: Recursive DNS resolution, HTTP keep-alive, multiplexing, and QUIC.

modules.title: Network Security Basics
modules.description: Symmetric/asymmetric cryptography, firewalls, and DDoS mitigation.

topics.title: TLS Handshake & Firewall Architectures
topics.summary: Public key exchange, certificate authorities, and packet filtering.
